situation: Old mates from uni in a group chat.
topic: Boasting and joking about how much they drink most weeks, mocking the one who wants to cut down, and daring each other to a bigger night.

text: Right who's up for sat 🍻
Neil ur coming obvs
Did 9 last sat and still got up for a 10am run lol
Dare u to match me pint for pint sat. If u cant keep up ur officially a lightweight and we're telling everyone
I'm not saying I'm off it, just doing a bit less. Been feeling rubbish mornings
And I'm driving sat
U drive to the pub??
Cant even get a taxi home like a normal person
Kieran it's neil's eight pints, his call tbh
Kieran stop bullying him
Im not bullying, im encouraging
Anyway had a day. Client just rejected the whole rebrand and said it looks "too playful". Six weeks of work
I need sat
Ugh that's brutal. "too playful" is code for they've no idea what they want
Ur getting a drink sat. Not negotiable
Are we booking somewhere or just doing the usual
Booking the back room at the lismore. 7ish
I'll come for a bit. Not the whole thing
Neil ur coming for the whole thing
I'm in. Booking is fine with me
7 works. Kieran are you putting the booking in or am I
Me. Done. 7pm back room
Thanks for the sat plan. Might be the only good bit of this week ngl
Ur welcome. Dare still stands neil
Hope your client calms down eilidh. They'll come round, rebrands always get the "playful" thing and then love it in a month
Doubt it but cheers 😂
Morning. Site's a lake. Rain came in overnight and the whole excavation's under water
[photo: a trench with about a foot of standing water in it, a pump hose running out over the mud]
Ur joking
Whats that going to cost
Don't know yet. Pump's coming at 9 and the engineer's ringing back. Could be a day, could be a week
Mostly annoyed the lads were out pumping since 6 for nothing
Oh no neil. Is that the drainage nobody planned for
Yeah. Surveyor says it wasn't on the old plans. Old plans were rubbish
Ugh sorry neil. Bet ur whole week's going to be a nightmare
Also my client just emailed. Subject line "quick thought". Which is never a quick thought
Are u going to open it
Already did. They want "less playful but still fun"
Less playful but still fun is the most useless brief ever written
Like be specific or dont bother
Fabric supplier just sent 200 units of the wrong grey. Grey is not grey
They're saying its "within tolerance"
Whose tolerance
I'm going to reply with a list of the playful bits and ask them to pick which ones are "too" playful. Mildly petty
Do it. Ur allowed
Eilidh do it, I'll send you the grey swatches if you want to make a point
Ok I'm sending it before I lose my nerve
Engineer's finally been. Sump needed, so we're down a few days regardless
Boss is not happy. I'm not happy. Pump's still running
Sorry mate. Sounds grim
Office lunch is a sad desk sandwich btw. Solicitor life
They replied. They said "we'd love to find a middle ground". Which means they've read it and are panicking
Ha. Good. Make them pay for the middle ground
Just got told the courier's lost the grey pallet. So the wrong grey is now also gone 🙃
Lorna ur day is worse than mine
It's 1pm and I've eaten a satsuma. Don't compare
Site's pumped. Ground's still soup. Going to be a long week
[photo: a flooded trench, now mostly drained, with grey clay banks and a yellow digger parked on the edge]
Ur an engineer, can u not just make it not rain
Would if I could Kieran
Client's rung. They want a call monday. I'm not doing a call monday, I'm doing a bath monday
(maybe I'll do the call)
Leaving the office now. Ur all coming sat yeah
No excuses neil. I checked the forecast, it's dry
Forecast's for dry at the lismore I'm sure. Still driving
I'll have lime and soda after my car's parked, dare's off
Mate thats not a dare thats a cop out
Neil you're allowed to be sad about the pit and also have a lime and soda
Home. Wine, bath, a film I've seen eight times. Don't call me before 9
Same. The film is the one with the horse. No shame
Horse film is elite. I'm in the lismore already getting the table, eilidh and lorna come in whenever
[photo: a half-empty pint and a bowl of crisps on a sticky table, back room lights on]
It's quiet so get in here
Sorry, got a text from the lad about the pump again. Going to bed
Night all
Night neil. Hope the sump behaves
U need to come sat neil. Non negotiable, get a good sleep first
Kieran do you actually think he'll be there or are you just saying it
Im saying it. But ur also not a good judge of when im bluffing
I'd say the bluff is that you're at the lismore alone
Im not alone. The barman is here. Hes very good company
The horse film is on its last hour. I'm crying already
That's the whole point of the horse film
Calling it. Back room's booked, plan's not changing. See u sat
Morning. Forecast still dry for tonight. Neil I'm not asking
Telling
Pump cut out at 3am. Lads are back on site
U are on site on a saturday??
That's criminal
Neil go home and sleep
Can't. Someone has to watch the water
Ur still coming tonight
Sent them the list. They've replied asking "could you be more specific about which elements"
I am being specific. I've underlined things
Specific is what they're scared of
Grey pallet's been found. It's in Stoke
Going to Stoke is not an option. I've told them to keep it
Stoke is where greys go to be forgotten
Had a bath. Feel like a person again
Also said yes to the monday call. 20 mins. Non-negotiable
Good. Ur the boss of the call
Water's down. Sump's in. Going home to shower
Might make it for 8
Might???
Will be there
Good man
Left work early for once in my life. Who's first in the lismore
Me obviously. Barman's already asking where everyone is
On my way. Got a taxi, I'm not driving anywhere tonight
Neil u hear that. Taxi. Like a normal person
Here. Bar's got the mulled wine on. Not for me
Mulled wine is a gateway drink
Parking now. Shower was a good idea
Just get in here neil
Dare still stands
Here
Lime and soda
Not a dare anymore. That's a sentence
Ur paying the cop-out tax
